verdict.rationale: The evidence covers diffs, checkpoints, one-click undo, and Kanban auto-commit for code edits the agent makes, but nothing about versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the automations themselves, such as scheduled agents, skills, or headless workflow definitions. Rolling back an agent's file changes is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
